name: unraid-control
description: Full control of an Unraid server (Unraid OS 7.x, live-verified on Unraid OS 7.x / unraid-api 4.x) from Claude Code. Bundles an MCP server that authenticates to Unraid's official GraphQL API (api-key auth) and exposes both a generic GraphQL passthrough reaching the entire schema (Query/Mutation/Subscription, bundled offline since live introspection is disabled by default) and 99 curated tools for system health, the array & disks, Docker containers, VMs, shares, notifications, UPS, network, users/API keys, plugins and logs — plus a control skill and slash-command workflows. Also ships an opt-in SSH layer closing the gaps in Unraid's GraphQL API (which can operate but not create): editing a container's env vars, a full deployment layer (deploy custom containers and Community Applications apps as native dockerMan templates, compose stacks with auto-installed Compose Manager, and create VMs via vdisk + OVMF/q35 libvirt domain), plus file management (list/read/write/mkdir/move/copy/delete) and share management (create/delete via cfg + emcmd). All create/deploy/write/delete tools are confirm-gated (recursive/data deletes double-gated), system paths and protected VMs are refused.
